nom: I Dew Care Gold Kitten Revitalizing Golden Peel-Off Mask

avis.texte: I finally found a replacement for a 24k peel off mask. I was nervous about the reviews, but after using it I instantly fell in love! Yes, the product is thick, so I recommend using the spatula. When you go over the spot, the product softens which makes it easier to spread. The thickness is a plus for me because I sweat a lot throughout my t zone. The mask doesn't drip down my face. I have oily skin, acne prone skin, and my face is puffy. This mask helps as well as my eye mask I sleep with from earth therapeutics. The strong smell is fine for me. Lastly, I left this mask on for over an hour and the peel off was as smooth as butter. Hope this helped someone. I came back to purchase two bottles.

I got a sample of this in one of my Ulta orders. It was easy to apply. The fragrance is kind of overwhelming—very perfume-y. It wasnt too hard to peel off, but it wasn't painless. It also left my skin feeling pretty dry after I'd done a lot of consistent skincare to get my skin barrier good again. I threw the sample away after one use.
I have a few different masks from I Dew. I really like the products. I can tell a difference and my face feels moisturized and refreshed! I will defintely repurchase!

I don't think this product does anything to benefit the skin. It has a strong scent, dries too quickly to apply evenly, and isn't a true peel-off mask. Once dried, it just gives a temporary tightening effect and leaves a residue that's hard to rinse off. Strong smell, hard to apply, not a true peel-off mask, and leaves no real skin benefits.

Was curious about the gold in this mask. It is thick from jar not dried out. Pretty easy to spread on. Once dried I started to peel off and ouch. It really hung on to my skin even though I did it slow. Really irritated my occasionally sensitive skin. Would not buy again for this reason. I did like the tight smoothness of my skin. Will try on chest since I have some left.
This mask has WAY too much fragrance in it, to the point that it's overwhelming. Definitely do not recommend this product as it will suffocate you.

avis.titre: Just like the what the influencers use
avis.texte: Influencers always make videos about super gold masks. This mask looks exactly like it and feels great!
The texture is very gummy and barely spreadable. The scent is strong and chemically like one you'd find in a salon, making it feel… not-so-natural.

I only used this a couple of times before the product itself changed. It was easier to use when i first got it, then in under three months it became very bouncy and tacky in texture, like it didn't want to come away from itself. Made it very difficult to spread evenly on the skin.

Because I was a really fat kid in the '60s, God showed mercy on me by giving me a perfect complexion. I've never had a zit, blackhead or pore problem, in all of my 63 yrs. Then came menopause. No, no zits, just big pores on my nose. I almost tried Biore, but couldn't bring myself to do it after never needing it. I put a nice layer of this mask on my face, especially my nose. After peeling it off, I didn't recognize my nose!!! Yeah, it worked wonders on the rest of my face, but my nose was transformed!! Not a single visible pore!!! You gotta try this!

When I recieved this it was a freebie for placing a qualifying order. When I opened it, the top was tacky and dry at the same time. It was difficult to mix to get to what I thought was a spreadable portion but even that was difficult to spread. If I had spent money on it, I would have been disappointed.
I received this sample through ulta and its been my go to ever since. I like how the product peels off and takes away the yeck with it.

I have used all kinds of masks, expensive ones, cheap ones and to be honest, this one worked as well if not better than some of the most expensive ones. At first, it's kinda sticky when u open it up, but I took my finger and kind of mixed it up and the applied to my face. I was really impressed with the brightening of my face. My face was brighter and looked smoother than it was. I was given a sample of this in one of my free gifts from Ulta, I liked it so much that I'm on here today to buy more.

avis.titre: I really wanted to love it...
avis.texte: I was very hopeful for this mask as it said firming and cruelty free but unfortunately found it very gummy and hard to spread. The smell is strong and my face was burning after 5 minutes...will be returning.

I got this as a gift so I didn't know the spatula was sold separately. Used my fingers and it was a messy and patchy ordeal. 20 mins later and I had to force myself to stop rubbing my face from how soft it felt. Fun mask that I can see myself ordering after I run out
I got this as a free gift, unmm i opened it and it was like gummy dry type. It does have a strong scent. But it did leave my skin soft. It felt a little tingly afterwards. Not worth 23 dollars tho
Received a free sample as a gift with purchase. Two things about this mask: it left my skin very dry after 15 minutes and it removed the peach fuzz. Threw the rest of the sample out.
This mask is very gummy and hard to put on. It looks nothing like the pictures shown. I would nor recommend.
I love cake my day. This is not that. The perfume is so strong! My eyes immediately started watering. It's thick as if it's expired/ dried out. Went on clumpy.
This product made my skin red and ichy and took a week to go away but my friend was fine so i dont know if its just my skin type or something, so just be careful!
The mask takes over 40 minutes to dry. Doesnt feel like its takinf anything off my face. BIG BUMMER. I wanted to love this brand. Bummer because I bought 3 different ones from this brand.

I was so excited to try this mask but when I opened it, it had the most gummy thick texture and the smell is so overpowering. It smells like fake roses/perfume and made me so nauseous. I couldn't leave it on for more than 5 minutes. I can't believe how much they are charging for this, definitely returning and getting my money back.
I see from the video, as i suspected, its supposed to be thin like their other peel off masks. Its thick like goo as if it got too much air but was surely sealed when i opened it.

avis.titre: Way too strong of fragrance & thick texture
avis.texte: Returning this. The fragrance is way overpowering and was so intense, I could taste it. Gross. Plus the texture is much thicker and less spreadable than the space kitten charcoal masque. Not at all worth the money.
This mask was soo great! I got it in a sample pack from Ulta and it js absolutely amazing. It did not leave my face oily at all and has a nice cooling feeling. Definitely recommend
Nice rubber-like consistency, nice looking when on, but did not feel any difference in moisturizing or looking of pores.
This mask made me literally cough while applying it becasue the smell of alcohol was that overwhelming. Its also a harsh formula, my cheeks were red after one use

I love this mask it is so cute! Love the gold color it feels so luxurious when I apply the mask to my face! I would definitely recommend to any skincare lover or anyone who loves self care! I was gifted by idewcare

Gold kitten peel off mask - I use to be love peel mask bath I haven't used one in awhile. This mask feels nourishing on the skin. This one is made with pumpkin enzyme to give it a nice exfoliating, it is made with mica so it gives it that extra sheen. This mask leaves mg skin softer and brighter. Interesting.

Gifted by idewcare. The New Gold Revitalizing peel off mask is my new favorite mask! The texture is so unique! Like a non sticky gum that spreads over your skin easily. I was surprised it was not messy at all! No dripping and once it dries it didn't feel as tight as others I have used before. Peeling it off is not painful or uncomfortable and my skin felt amazing afterwards. As if it had removed all my impurities, silky smooth skin that lasts for days. It didn't feel stripping and I didn't experience any irritation. Overall an incredible find!

Didn't really like the application but I loved how it made my face feel and the after math of the mask. Really got into my pores cleaning them out and making my face feel super smooth. Doesn't hurt removing either. Gifted by idewcare

Omg, I didn't know I needed this. So perfect, made me feel like luxury. I love how I easy it was to use and take off. When I tell you nothing was left behind, nothing was left behind. Man go get you one, it's such a must have. This was gifted by idewcare

I really loved this IDew Care Gold Kitten Revitalizing Peel Off Mask! It left my skin feeling amazing! Plus it peeled off nicely!!! Other peel off masks don't peel off that great, but this truly did! It was also easy to apply which is nice.

Super fun way to do a mask. Easy to use and dries up in 20 minutes with easy peel off that does not irritate or hurt your skin. Leaves your skin feeling so smooth and glowing. Cute packaging. Great price. Gifted by idewcare

This is such a beautiful mask but applying it is a lot of work. It's very clumpy and impossible to spread smoothly and evenly. I really wish it came with its own spatula too. But I feel it kind of redeems itself with the results. It doesn't burn when it's on but it does feel cold and tingly which I like. It takes quite a while to dry even with a fan but once it's peeled off my skin looks and feels smooth, radiant and plumper. I'd give it five stars for that but the application is just not as satisfying as it should be. In the jar it looks so smoothe and creamy but once you dig in it's chunky. If you don't mind the work to lay it down you might love the immidiate results. Gifted by I Dew Care

I received this product complimentary from I Dew Care in exchange for my honest review. This peel off mask is designed with exfoliating and moisturizing ingredients to help soften and smooth. It has a thick sticky texture that can be spread out into a thin layer that sets in 15-20 minutes to peel off easily. The scent is a little too perfume heavy for my preferences but it does work well on my skin. I found that it left my skin feeling very soft and nicely hydrated. I liked that it peeled off easily and helped my skin look better.

Omg this mask is so good! It applies evenly and nicely on the skin. After taking it off, my skin felt sooo smooth and soft! This mask is super refreshing. Also really love the gold color. It's so pretty and luxurious! Gifted by I dew care.

Gifted by idewcare. A peel off mask?! Say no more. I was so excited to try this and it definitely exceeded my expectations. The smell is a bit strong but I don't have a problem with it since it didn't give my skin any issues. I have sensitive skin so I'm really happy with how this mask didn't break out my skin and how it is fun to peel off haha.

This is such a fun gold mask that I was gifted by I dew care. I apply to my face and it gets tight and then I peel it off. My daughter likes using it too. My face feels refreshed after it is removed. I use it weekly.

This was gifted to me by i dew care and has definitely become one of my favorites! The gold color makes the product look very luxe and expensive and really does wonders for your skin. The peeling off process is fun and the thick consistency makes it easy when it dries up. Leaves your skin looking very bright and refreshed

This mask is just was I was looking for ! It made my skin look so fresh and left a nice glow. It peeled off beautifully and I have extreme dry skin, but this mask didn't dry my skin at all. The texture is a bit thick, so it gets hard to apply evenly. This was gifted by idewcare for my honest review!

I've been dealing with dull skin and so I was very excited to try this peel off mask. The texture of the mask was thick enough that it didn't slide off my face and it dried quickly. removing the mask wasn't painful and it left my skin glowing and feeling brand new. Gifted by Idewcare

Gifted by I dew care. It's a nice mask that works for my combo oily. I like that my pores feel very tight after use.they claim thatThis revitalizing peel-off mask helps reveal a supple and youthful-looking complexion! Its golden formula is infused with real 24K gold powder, peptides and pumpkin extract, providing dry and dull skin with a radiant glow. I recommend for young people.

I was gifted by Gold Kitten for my honest option. This is a fun way to revitalize my skin, with the gold texture to this peel-off mask. I love how it brightens and leaves my skin feeling fresh. Easy to peel off once fully dry. The gold adds a touch of feeling fancy.

I'm not usually a peel mask person but this product applied so smooth, it smells good but it's a little too strong for me. My favorite part is how easy it was to remove, most peel off masks rip off in small pieces and requires me to cleanse my face again to get all the little sticky pieces off but this came off in ONE PIECE. It looked like a sheet mask when I took it off (still in the shape of my face) my skin was smooth and glowing. Great product! Gifted by idewcare

avis.titre: Worth the mess of getting it on(x

It's a little tricky to put on at first but it's definitely worth it! I was gifted by I Dew Care in exchange for an honest review.(:

I was gifted by idewcare. I Loved this peel off face mask. I liked how it's thicker than any others I'd tried. Dried pretty quickly, too. The gold color is so so pretty. It does have a very strong floral-ish scent which isn't my favorite. I prefer light scent or no scent. Once the mask dried, it peeled off on one piece!! That's very rare it happens! Overall I did like this mask. I would repurchase.

I was gifted by idewcare and I love it! It felt so nice and refreshing on my face. It didn't make me break out which I appreciated because I have very sensitive skin! It was very smoothing & soft! 10/10!

avis.titre: Such a beautiful mask! Easy to peel off!
avis.texte: This peel off mask is so fun and cute! I apply it liberally all over my face and then wait 20 minutes until it's dry. Then it's so easy to peel off and rinse off the excess. Afterwards my skin is so soft and bright all day!

One things about me is I'm a sucker for a good peel off mask. I love the gold texture on this mask and it's super easy and fun to apply. After I peel it off my skin feels so nice and replenished. This was gifted by idewcare

This mask is the perfect go-to addition for mixing up your skin care routine! I love the way it made my skin look glowy and younger looking even after one use. The 24k gold added an interesting texture to the mask, but was great overall. Gifted by idewcare.

avis.titre: Smooth firm skin with a wonderful scent
avis.texte: I recieved the I Dew Care, gold kitten revitalizing peel off mask as a gift in return for my honest review. The first thing I noticed was the delightful gold color of the product. It's infused with real 24k gold powder! It smells delightful & fresh as it contains pumpkin extract. When applying the product it felt smooth and cooling. After using the mask my skin felt firmer & I felt a fresh glow. The packaging is cute too.

Gold kitten revitalizing peel off mask is so amazing to use! My skin looks brighter and more clear after using it. It's easy to apply and you don't have to use much to make the mask work. I'm super impressed with it!

Love this peel-off mask! The 24K gold-infused formula is a game-changer for my dry skin, leaving it radiant and smooth. Easy to apply and peel off, plus it's cruelty-free and clean. Highly recommend for a quick, effective glow boost! Gifted by idewcare

this gold mask is absolutely gorgeous! it's super hydrating and satisfying to peel off. this removes all of my dead skin and leaves my face feeling smooth and exfoliated. this product was gifted by idewcare.

The I Dew Care Gold Kitten Peel Off Mask is a skincare gem! This mask not only adds a touch of luxury with its gold shimmer but also delivers on results. The peel-off feature makes it easy to use, and it leaves my skin feeling refreshed and rejuvenated. The formula seems to work wonders, leaving my skin smoother and giving it a healthy glow. If you're into pampering yourself and want a mask that combines effectiveness with a touch of glamour, the Gold Kitten Peel Off Mask is a must-try. (gifted by I Dew Care)

Gifted by i dew care. Not only does this mask look cool because of the gold color and the amazing texture but it helps tremendously with brightening your skin. It feels moisturized and plump after use. Another thing is it smells so good. Overall, this mask is great for brightening and help your skin achieve a radiant glow

I love I dew care!!! This mask is unlike others. It applies on so smoothly. Make sure you wash your face before too and make sure it's dry so that the mask applies on super well! I love that it peels vs me having to wash it off with a wash cloth!!! I left it on for 20 min and it helped my skin look SO glowy!! My husband loved it too. Offered by idewcare

I use this peel off mask twice a week and I love it. The ingredients are great, such as 24K gold powder. It's very easy to apply. I let it dry and peel it off. My skin looks plumb and firm. It gives me a youthful look. Gifted by idewcare.

It is the best peel off mask I have ever used.It brightened my face and also reduced acne marks.I finished one pack and definitely going to repurchase it.Love all the I dew cares products complimentary from I dew care

this brand is one of my favorite to get face masks from! They are always so unique but work at the same time! I love how glowy my skin looks after I use this! My face always feels so fresh and clean! Gifted by idewcare

i love me a good peel off mask after a long day. after using i feel that this mask really pulls the impurities out of my skin and leaves me skin feeling so soft and clean. i especially love the way it cleans out my pores! i was gifted by idewcare

I was gifted by I Dew Care. This product is great, first time using it. And pleasantly surprised. I have dry and sensitive skin so I wasn't sure how my skin would react to the product. It feels smooth and soft after the first use.

Love my gold peel-off mask. This product is pure gold, both literally and figuratively. The formula is rich and luxurious, and it glides onto the skin effortlessly. As it dries, you can feel it tightening and firming, leaving your skin looking and feeling refreshed and rejuvenated. And Peeling it off is so satisfying! Not only does it remove dead skin cells and impurities, but it also leaves behind a radiant and glowing complexion. Gifted by Idewcare

I received this product complimentary from I DEW CARE. This is a fabulous mask. The formula looks like a very thick gold paste. I use a spatula to apply it to my clean dry skin, wait about 20 minutes until it is dry and then just peel off. It leaves my skin looking so smooth and plump. Really makes it glow. I also love the clean ingredients in this mask.

I like peel off masks, and was excited to try this one. I like that it's gentle on my skin. It takes time to get used to applying evenly but it's pretty easy. It peels off easily. My skin feels smooth and tighter afterwards. Gifted by I Dew Care.

#gifted #gifted by idewcare My skin felt smoother after using this mask and the overall complexion looked brighter too after using this. The gold texture of this formula is smooth even going on the face. It does feel sticky and thicker in texture.

This face mask was amazing! The peel-off is so satisfying and left my skin feeling soft and supple. It has a nice gold color and is a super fun way to take care of your skin. This was gifted by idewcare.

This gold mask is great for revitalizing skin and is easily one of my favorite masks to reach for on those self care nights! The gold feels luxurious on the skin and after removing it makes my skin feel super soft! Definitely recommend! This was gifted by idewcare

Loving the way my skin looks! This product has helped my significantly with the texture of my skin. It doesn't really have a strong scent to the product and it's not messing to take off. It's really pretty once you have it on gifted by idewcare

The product was super easy to use and apply onto the face. Also the mask smells really good, doesn't have too much of an overwhelming smell. I will say it did leave my skin feeling very fresh and clean. Definitely would recommend! gifted by idewcare.

This mask has brightened my skin and felt soft. The process of applying the mask onto my skin was a bit difficult, this consistency is very thick so takes a bit to dry. It does peel off easily and doesn't hurt. I do recommend this mask. Gifted by I Dew Care.

I was gifted by dewcare. I am obsessed with this peel off mask it was easy to use and smelled good it left my face feeling smooth and glowing. It was definitely fun to peel off. Can't wait to use again.

Gifted by I dew care. Peel off masks are sometimes rough on the skin but this didn't leave my skin red or irritated. It worked well on my sensitive skin. Can't wait to see how it makes my skin look after multiple times.

I'm very picky with my faces masks however this one checked all my boxes. The texture is just so nice and the gold color is beautiful. I was offered by idewcare and will definitely be repurchasing as this is my favorite mask. It peels off so so easy!

i got this gifted by I Dew Care and i wish i had more to say about it. The texture was very thick and sticky so it was a bit messy n harder than expected to get out and apply. The mask also didnt quite stick to my face enough while it dried it started peeling early. Left my skin feeling alright but didn't pull as much as expected unfortunately.

I was gifted this product by IDewCare to try for free from Skeepers for my honest opinion. My first impression of the Gold Kitten Peel Off Mask is that it is very thick. Therefore when applying it to my clean and dry face it still clumped in areas. It's very hard to apply since this didn't come with an applicator. When going over previous areas it didn't mix together very well leaving it clumpy and uneven. It says to leave it on for 20-30 minutes but I felt like I had to leave it on for about 40 minutes just to feel like it was fully dry and easier to remove. Once it was done and cleaned up it did make my face feel tighter and more refreshed. Offered by idewcare

I received this product gifted by Skeepers, and i'm honestly amazed on how this mask left my skin feeling. It doesn't irritate my skin, and leaves a hydrating fresh feeling. I was surpised by the texture though, it's not as running like normal face masks, it's thick.

avis.titre: So much fun and really adds a glow effect to your skin!
avis.texte: I tried this mask complimentary from idewcare. I use it when my skin is dry and dull and after I peel it off, it really gives my skin a glowy look! The pumpkin extract is very good for your skin and the 24K gold is really fun to paint on too! Instant glow.

This is the best peel off mask I've tried so far. I love that my pores feel so nice and clean after I use this mask. I also recommend washing your face afterwards for a super fresh feel and look. My skin feels so soft and looks brighter after using it. complimentary from idewcare

Received this gifted by idewcare but opinion is my own. LOVE the convenience of this mask! It deters me from using face masks when the application is messy like a sheet mask, so I love how this one just dries and you can peel it off. Formula and consistency is a thick gold paste. I used a spatula to apply it which was ideal since the product was super thick. Took awhile to dry but my face was so soft and tight after removing!

This peel off mask is perfect. The color of it is actually GOLD! After removing this peel off mask, my skin was super glowy and smooth. I have combination skin and this product worked worked really good with my skin. offered by idewcare

avis.titre: This is my favorite peel off mask!
avis.texte: I recently received a jar of Gold Kitten Revitalizing Peel-Off Mask complimentary from I Dew Care, and I absolutely love this mask. I have always loved peel off masks, and this one exceeded my expectations. The gold texture of the mask is really cool, it just looks and feels amazing. I really enjoyed the whole experience, from application of the mask all the way up to the process of peeling it off. The peel was especially satisfying, as the mask actually came off in one piece. And my skin feels amazing now! So soft and smooth. I can't wait until the weekend for my next self care day. I will definitely buy this product again.

I've tried a lot of products to get rid of my acne scars and dark spots, but these sheet masks gifted by Gold Kitten is the best results so far! I love the scent and how light it feels. It has a cooling sensation and feels very relaxing. I started seeing results within the first week of use. Now my skin is so clear that people constantly seem to think I have a full face of makeup on when it's just my bare skin.

I Dew Care's Gold Kitten Revitalizing Mask is a skincare gem! ✨🐱 I was gifted by idewcare, but I love this mask so much. This mask doesn't just look adorable with its cute packaging; it delivers real results. The gold infusion leaves my skin looking refreshed and radiant. It's a pampering treat that not only feels luxurious but also hydrates and revitalizes. Plus, the application is a breeze. If you're into self-care and want a mask that feels as good as it looks, give this mask a try!

Gifted by I Dew Care. The gooey textured mask containing 24k gold and pumpkin extract is a bit tricky to applied. In cleanse skin, I use a silicon brush to ease worn application. I leave it on for about 30 minutes before peel off. Upon removal, my skin feels smooth and looks revitalize . It's a great skin treatment to use a couple times a week.

I love the gold texture of this gold kitten mask, it's so nice on my skin! It makes my skin so soft and glowy I can never live without it tbh!! I will be restocking this forever once it runs out! Gifted by I dew care

I love this mask! It makes my skin feel so soft after using and it didn't give my any weird reactions! It's really pretty on my skin and I would recommend this to everyone. I received this complimentary from Skeepers.

The gold peel off mask was gifted by I Dew care in exchange for my honest review. The gold texture feels very luxurious with its formulation of 24k gold, peptide and pumpkin extract. I like to apply it at the last step of my night skincare routine. After washing off, it left my skin smoother and more radiant. Love it!

The I Dew Care Gold Kitten Revitalizing Peel-Off Mask is a treat for the skin that left me feeling pampered and refreshed. The texture of the mask is not only visually appealing but also contributes to its effectiveness, as the peel-off feature helps to unclog pores and reveal a brighter complexion. gifted by idewcare

Gifted by idewcare. I Dew Care's Gold Kitten Peel-Off Mask is a fun and effective treat for your skin. The peel-off formula refreshes, leaving you with a golden glow. A purrfect addition to your skincare routine, I even share it with my 6 year old daughter.

I was gifted by idewcare the Gold Kitten Revitalizing peel off mask. This was was a fun mask to apply. The scent leans floral which is not my preference but is not overpowering. I loved the gooey texture and golden shimmer. It dries down and really tightens. I was worried it would not peel off easily but it did. My skin was left feeling nice & soft.

Gifted by idewcare in exchange for an honest review. Gifted by idewcare. I love the beautiful gold texture of this product. It was easy to apply. I covered my face and neck with it using a brush. It dried in I would say 15 minutes. It was easy to peel off. It left my skin looking cleansed, soft and exfoliated.

I received this complimentary from I Dew Care. This is such a fun mask! I've been looving I Dew Care products and have been so impressed with the results after using this mask! 10/10 i'd buy again and recommend jt.

This is truly such a fun mask to apply, it's gooey but lays down evenly when you apply it with the tool it comes with. ABSOLUTELY LOVE THIS FOR MY SKIN!!! It's definitely a must have to your skin care routine. As someone who was looking and looking for a product to brighten up my face, this product answered all of my questions!! Gifted by idewcare

The mask boasts a luxurious gold infusion, adding a touch of opulence to the skincare routine. The golden hue enhances the overall experience, making it feel like a pampering session. I've used it once and instantly i felt my skin look more radiant and more plump! It's a really nice face mask and it looks cute while on giving luxury with the gold! I was left with my skin feeling smoother and glowy! My skin felt nicer so i will be using more often! it was super easy to apply! gifted by idewcare

This was gifted by I Dew Care. I didn't like this mask. It was extremely hard to apply to my face. It was too thick and goopy, but also seemed too dried out. I couldn't get a good layer on my face to be able to peel off, so I had to rinse it off. There was also wayyy too much fragrance, it made my skin and eyes sting when I first put this on. This product was a fail for me.

This product was gifted by idewcare. I did not like this mask. The texture was goopy and thick. It didn't spread smoothly. I also wish the product came with a spatula to apply. The removal was painful. It was pulling my skin and since I'm prone to broken capillaries and vessels I don't think this was good for me to use. The skin did feel smooth after using so that's a positive

I love a peel-off mask and this beautiful golden mask offered by idewcare really gives my skin a beautiful glow. It's really easy to apply and even easier to peel off. I like that my skin felt smoother and looked firmer after using.

Indulge in luxury with the Gold Kitten Revitalizing Peel-Off Mask. Easy to apply, it tightens pores while infusing skin with antioxidants and hydration. After use, my complexion felt rejuvenated and radiant. A must-have for anyone seeking a pampering skincare experience.

Gifted by I Dew Care, I was super excited to try out their skincare since I had heard so many good things about their products. I am a huge fan of Korean skincare and this mask leaves my skin with a glowing effect and hydrated.

Gifted by idewcare in exchange for my honest opinion. I applied this mask to clean dry skin and I have normal/combination skin seasonally. The texture of this mask is so thick that it was challenging even applying it to the face. If you have any kind of facial hair tread carefully. This mask will gladly remove it for you by force. A downside to this formulation is the downtime. It took a long time to dry down. It is SUPER SATISFYING to peel off. If I applied too little to the face it was hard to peel, but apply too much and you'll have pockets of unset mask. I didn't notice any real hydration benefits while using it but my skin did have a little bit of added luminosity. It's not a mask I would recommend for all over the face but I will continue to use it on my nose, chin, and forehead.
